tools.name: calendar_list
tools.description: List upcoming and currently active calendar events synced from system calendar or CalDAV.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 20).

summary.zh: 按时间顺序列出近期与进行中的日历事件。
summary.en: List upcoming and active calendar events in chronological order.

tools.name: calendar_sync
tools.description: Immediately sync calendar events from system calendar and CalDAV subscriptions.

summary.zh: 立即从系统日历与 CalDAV 订阅同步日程。
summary.en: Immediately sync calendar events from OS calendar and CalDAV subscriptions.

tools.name: calendar_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge and mute further interval reminders for a specific calendar event.

event.description: Event key, uid, or title keyword from calendar_list.

summary.zh: 静默指定区间日程的后续重复提醒。
summary.en: Mute further interval reminders for a specific calendar event.

description.zh: 日历提醒 World 挂载并完成首次同步，附带近期日程摘要。
description.en: Calendar Reminder World mounted and completed initial sync.

description.zh: 点任务到点，或区间任务开始/按设定频率重复提醒。
description.en: A point event came due, or an interval event started/repeated.

description.zh: 开启结束提醒时，区间任务到达结束时间。
description.en: An interval event reached its end time (when notifyOnEnd is enabled).

prompts.title: 日历提醒 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
这是一个日历提醒 World：定期从本机系统日历与 CalDAV / ICS 订阅同步日程，到点由 World 主动推事件叫你，不需要轮询。
当前时间 {{calendar.now}}；{{calendar.summary}}；下一条日程是 {{calendar.next}}。
当收到 `calendar.due` 或 `calendar.ended` 事件时，用自然、简短的语气提醒用户（若当前环境有 `pet_say` 等播报工具可一并调用）；如果用户表示某条进行中的区间日程不再需要继续提醒，可调用 `calendar_ack` 静默该条日程的后续重复提醒。
用户询问近期日程或要求立即刷新日历时，可调用 `calendar_list` 或 `calendar_sync`。
